rules.broken: 20+ ratings, 70%+ one-star, and under 60% of users ever rendered a game window on Adreno + Turnip in the current release (or no telemetry)
rules.likely_broken: 20+ ratings, 50%+ one-star, under 60% rendered or no telemetry
rules.first_run_friction: 50%+ one-star but 60%+ of users render the game eventually
rules.window: the verdict uses ratings from the current app release when a game has 20+ of them, else the last 14 days when it has 20+, else the 90-day history (verdict_window = release | recent | carried_over)
rules.recovered: the current release shows the game rendering for most users and the last 14 days of ratings are no longer mostly one-star
